name: Velvet Antenna v0.20.4 Standalone
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna release. v0.20.4 fixes duplicate filtering so unresolved cards cannot leak into duplicate results, requires corroborating title evidence for provider-ID matches, and retains Needs ID, native multi-select, playback, Series/Season and metadata-management functionality.

name: Velvet Antenna v0.21.0 Velvet Lens
author: James
description: Standalone Velvet Antenna redesign focused on speed and a distinct browsing identity. Adds persistent Back navigation, the dynamic Velvet Lens library stage, whole-library Needs ID and duplicate workbenches, stable Home hero, strict local playback, native Series/Season rendering, subtitles and metadata editing.
